reviews.text: App crashes every time I try to export to PDF. This is really frustrating!
Would love to see a dark mode option. My eyes hurt using the app at night.
Absolutely love this app! It's changed how I manage my projects. Best purchase ever!
The login button doesn't work on Safari browser. Please fix ASAP.
Can you add integration with Notion? That would be amazing for my workflow.

bug_report.summary: App crashes when exporting to PDF.
steps_to_reproduce: Attempt to export a document to PDF.
bug_report.expected_behavior: The document should be successfully exported to PDF without crashing.
bug_report.actual_behavior: The app crashes every time the export to PDF is attempted.

bug_report.summary: Login button non-functional on Safari browser.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the application in Safari browser.
Attempt to click the login button.
bug_report.expected_behavior: The login button should be clickable and allow user to log in.
bug_report.actual_behavior: The login button does not respond to clicks.

feature_spec.problem: Users experience eye strain when using the app at night due to bright screen light.
feature_spec.proposed_solution: Implement a dark mode option that users can toggle on or off, which changes the app's color scheme to darker tones.
feature_spec.user_benefit: Reduced eye strain and improved user comfort during nighttime use, leading to increased user satisfaction and longer app usage sessions.
success_metrics: Increased user engagement during nighttime hours

feature_spec.proposed_solution: Develop an integration that allows users to sync data between the app and Notion seamlessly.
feature_spec.user_benefit: Improved workflow efficiency by reducing manual data transfer, saving time, and minimizing errors.
